lines.trans: In this story you are a lonely widow, and two lonely souls cross paths.
Then they seek each other passionately — that emotional contrast is what matters.
Cut! No good — Miku, step over here a minute.
What was wrong with my take?
Don't give me that phony acting — if you think I'm the same as Ikezawa, you're dead wrong.
I'm facing you with everything on the line; I'll catch whatever you give, so bare it all.

words.gram: Noun in the idiom 気が向く (feel like doing).

lines.trans: Try doing it for real just once.
I can't do that!
Director, that's a bad idea — nobody in the industry has ever heard of filming it for real.
That is precisely why I'm proposing it — and I will take full responsibility.
There is zero point in my filming fake intimacy anymore.
I won't force you — you decide for yourself.

meanings.note: All-purpose action verb; turns Sino-Japanese nouns into verbs (融通する, 出店する) and with に means 'decide on' or 'make into'.

examples.text: 一度食べてみてください。

examples.trans: You won't know unless you try.

examples.trans: The two of us go together.

meanings.note: Plain sentence-ending copula; contracts or shifts to だった in past, だろう/だろ for supposition, and で/じゃ in combinations.
Calls someone's attention ('look here!') or asks for a brief pause (ちょっと待って).

examples.text: ちょっと待ってください。
ちょっと見てください。

meanings.note: Irregular verb: くる -> きます -> きました.

examples.text: 何を買いにきましたか。

meanings.en: come into existence; be completed; can do

meanings.note: Polite/dialectal negative ending, especially in ～ません.
In casual speech, それ plus は often fuses into そりゃ ('well, as for that / of course').
Colloquial quotative/emphatic particle expressing surprise or dismissal.

examples.text: そんなことなんて知らない。
examples.trans: I don't know anything like that.

examples.text: 嘘だなんて信じられない。

meanings.note: Refers to facts, matters, or affairs rather than physical objects (もの).
